raw_text: In the quantum analog dyads design document, a "model-as-common-cause" null hypothesis was added alongside a W state section. The null holds that when two readings of a dyad agree, the agreement may come from both being produced by the same underlying model, not from any real correlation in the material. A related "joint-read" idea was also added to the document's design section. Under joint-read, paired items are read together, not independently, which separates genuine relational structure from artifacts of the shared generator.
